text:
maria-support: Customer reports a redeemed promo code (VID-UX-2026) — UI shows success and they got the confirmation email, but account balance didn't change and usage shows 0 credits. Org: org_89214. Can someone take a look?

sam-dev: thanks — can you paste the webhook payload or request id from the UI confirm email? any request ids from the redemption flow?

maria-support: forwarded the customer's confirmation email. They included `req_0a9b2f` and the redemption code `VID-UX-2026`. Quick repro steps I ran: 1) customer clicks Redeem -> success modal 2) confirmation email with code 3) account page still shows $0 credits.

maria-support: attaching the webhook ack we received (copying payload):

```
{ 
  "event": "promo.redeem",
  "code": "VID-UX-2026",
  "org_id": "org_89214",
  "status": "accepted",
  "request_id": "req_0a9b2f",
  "timestamp": "2026-11-03T16:42:01Z"
}
```

billing-bot: ledger_write: FAILED -> FK_VOUCHER_ORG_MISMATCH (code: 4092), trace_id=trace_77c4

sam-dev: billing-bot shows FK mismatch — looks like the grant was created but failed the ledger write due to organization mapping. did the customer recently switch SSO / migrate org id?

oliver-ops: checking our ingest pipeline for that trace_id. quick grep shows the voucher record inserted with `org_ref: "org-legacy-89214"` but the ledger expects canonical `org_89214`. likely a mapping regression from the SSO migration job.

oliver-ops: short term we can manually create a ledger entry mapping to `org_89214` and re-run the reconcile. need approval from CS to modify billing ledger.

jenna-cs: customer is on a tight timeline, asked for an ETA. Approved manual apply if it gets them credits today. Please include a note we performed a manual grant and reason (SSO id mismatch).

sam-dev: i'll run the manual apply script now. command: `python tools/manual_credit_apply.py --org org_89214 --amount 1000 --code VID-UX-2026 --trace trace_77c4`

sam-dev: executed, got response:
```
{ "status": "ok", "ledger_entry_id": "led_90231", "applied_to": "org_89214" }
```

billing-bot: ledger_write: OK -> led_90231 (trace_id=trace_77c4)

maria-support: customer confirms they now see 1000 credits in the account page. thanks team! Mentioned they'd like a short note explaining what happened so they can file internally.

oliver-ops: root cause: SSO migration created a legacy org_ref form (`org-legacy-89214`) that our promo ingestion didn't reconcile. Action items: 1) add reconciliation fallback in promo ingestion (sam) 2) run a one-time full reconcile for last 30 days (ops) 3) add a quick alert on FK_VOUCHER_ORG_MISMATCH (prod) (oliver).

sam-dev: filing followups — created ticket INF-4621 to add fallback mapping and tests.

jenna-cs: I'll send the customer a short summary and confirmation of the manual credit. closing once they acknowledge. :white_check_mark:
